classification.difficultyReason: Read intersection, union and complements directly from a supplied two-set Venn diagram.

spec.description: Overlapping circles A and B inside the universal-set rectangle. Source blue numerical labels become ordinary black labels under house style; all region memberships are preserved.
spec.mathematics: A only={1,3}; A intersection B={12,2,4,8}; B only={6,10}; outside both={5,7,9,11}.
spec.answerVisibility: All boundaries, set labels and numerical elements are permanent student givens. Supplied response answers are excluded.

answer.worked: The overlap contains the elements belonging to both sets: $A\cap B=\{12,2,4,8\}$.
Include every element inside either circle, counting each element once: $A\cup B=\{1,3,2,12,4,8,6,10\}$.
Take all elements in the universal set outside circle $A$, including those in $B$ only: $A'=\{5,7,9,6,10,11\}$.
Take all elements in the universal set outside circle $B$, including those in $A$ only: $B'=\{1,3,5,7,9,11\}$.
